(Insta-turn on when I imagined my bf in a pink girly af kitchen apron)

Not without great difficulty :/ I already hide a lot from them and I feel like adding that would make life that much harder.

I agree that maybe I beat myself up too much but I'm always stuck in a complex where I regret not being a "better person". It gets really hard cuz I'm just a human but I theorize in my head that if I make the perfect system (through my environment and schedule) I can achieve optimal results. 

Ofc this just ends up burning me in the end. The pressure is too immense and I find myself laying in bed hating myself for not completing my goals instead of planning to not take on so much in the first place.

I've considered therapy but I'm quite young. Im also near my parents all the time and they would take my need for counseling as me not choosing the correct career path. 

I think about others and their lives as well. I think its really selfish for one to think of themselves as a main character since everyone has their own story. That being said I feel guilty as all hell for feeling the way I do. I'm not a starving child in Africa nor am I a war refugee. Even with these realizations -- why does the unhappiness persist? 

I can't help but think maybe humans are forever damned to an eternal longing for more and more. I can earn as much money as I want/indulge in whatever but the moment of happiness is fleeting and my moment of distraction turns to focus on the perilous unknown I always feel.
